_readme: B-02: pinned llama.cpp build. fetch.py downloads both zips into build/out/llama and fails on any SHA-256 mismatch. Changing the pin is a reviewed change (CODEOWNERS): update release, commit, url and sha256 together. Digests are the ones GitHub publishes for the release assets. Builds are listed per platform (same ids as the platform layers); AIOS ships the windows set only. Another OS adds its own entry with its binary name.
